sprint.name: Sprint 41 - Invoice Read Path
sprint.goal: Cut p95 latency on the invoice list endpoint below 400ms.

issues.summary: Introduce a Redis cache in front of the invoice read path
issues.description: Stand up Redis as the caching layer for GET /api/customers/:id/invoices. Replace the Memcached wrapper in server/middleware/cache.js with a Redis client. Target a 5 minute TTL keyed by customer and date window.

issues.summary: Add pagination to the customer tier listing
issues.description: server/services/customer.service.js findByTier already pages at 50. Expose page size through the route and the DataTable component.

issues.summary: Null ISSUED_ON crashes the invoice date-window query
issues.description: AuroraORM between() emits a bind for null and Oracle throws ORA-01008. Guard in invoice.service.js.

issues.summary: Deprecate the legacy jQuery invoice grid
issues.description: Removed. All list views now use web/src/components/DataTable.jsx.

issues.summary: Migrate aurora-orm.js from callbacks to async/await
issues.description: Modernise the aurora-orm module: replace the callback-based query API with an async/await wrapper so the invoice service can drop its manual promisify helpers. Adopt native promises across every consumer of aurora-orm.

issues.summary: Stand up a GraphQL gateway for the invoice read APIs
issues.description: Introduce a GraphQL gateway in front of the invoice and customer read endpoints. Migrate the DataTable views to consume the new GraphQL schema instead of REST.
